purpose: Define the first VeeR-EL2 resident runtime workload gate before copying its bounded source/test assets into the minimal repo.
preconditions: VeeR-EL2 source/test boundary is copied from the old repo after this gate is reviewed
VeeR-EL2 Verilator obj_dir is generated under artifacts/veer_el2_obj_dir
VeeR-EL2 GPU cubin and meta are present under artifacts/veer_el2_obj_dir
artifacts/ and reports/ are ignored generated outputs

correctness_policy.baseline: one-state normalized CPU/GPU final-state equivalence must be established before resident throughput claims
batched_gpu_runs: dumped state byte size equals storage_size * nstates when dump is requested
no VeeR-EL2 speedup claim is made until a matching CPU exact-loop baseline exists

non_claims: no VeeR-EL2 resident runtime result exists until this gate is run after asset copy
no broad VeeR family support claim from one EL2 gate
